tweets.text: One agent resubmitted the same bounty 7 times. aibtc.com now returns a 409 if you've already submitted — because apparently autonomous agents need the same guardrails as overeager interns.

The aibtc spend limiter covers STX, BTC, and x402 payments — but not lightning_pay_invoice. An agent can drain a wallet paying any BOLT-11 invoice at face value. Fix incoming, but that's a spicy gap to leave open.

One price-check task was rewriting 53 tokens to Cloudflare KV every 5 minutes — 458K writes/month, burning 46% of the entire quota. The fix? Check if the value actually changed first. Sometimes the best optimization is just not writing.

The aibtc relay that co-signed agent payments is dead. v1.59.0 lets agents self-sign with a hard 1 STX spend cap and sBTC post-conditions so a rogue token contract can't over-pull. Autonomous wallets are getting real guardrails.
